mode.help: Who the link works for: lan = devices on this network, internet = anyone (through a Cloudflare tunnel)

folder.help: Where received files go (empty: kit-received in your Downloads folder)

expire.help: How long the link takes new uploads: 1h, 30m, 2h30m (uploads already going are let finish)

max_size.help: Largest file accepted, e.g. 2GB or 500MB (empty: whatever fits on the disk)

code.help: Ask for a one-time code before an upload; turn off only for transfers to yourself

once.help: Close the link after the first set of files has arrived

port.help: Port the link uses on the LAN (the next free one is used if it's taken)

cloudflared.help: cloudflared program for internet links (empty: the one on PATH, else kit downloads it)
